_comment: Synthetic judgement table for the agreement selftest. It contains no user text and no model output: every chip is a slot name, and the verdicts are hand-written. The expected block is the hand computation (see bench.py EXPECTED_AGREEMENT, which is checked against it).

_definitions.same: both judges call the chip directly sendable
_definitions.conservative: a chip counts only when BOTH judges accept it
_definitions.perMessage: denominator is every sampled message; a message hits when at least one of its chips hits

_hand_computation.perMessageSame: only m1 has a both-same chip -> 1/4 = 0.25
_hand_computation.perMessageSameOrNear: m1, m2, m3 each have a both-accepted chip -> 3/4 = 0.75
